professionalSummary: PMP‑certified project manager with four years of experience leading regulatory reporting change initiatives in a mid‑size bank, managing six projects under the bank’s change framework.  Demonstrated expertise in planning, budgeting, steering committee reporting, dependency management with reporting platform and finance teams, and delivering closure reports with regulator deadline evidence.  Prior experience includes two years as a project coordinator on a claims system replacement at an insurer.
experienceHighlights: Led six regulatory reporting change projects, each with a detailed plan, budget tracker, and monthly steering committee report.  Managed dependencies via the framework’s dependency log, escalating platform delays to the portfolio board.  Authored closure reports containing project boundary statements and regulator deadline evidence, all accepted by the change framework office.  Completed 35 contact hours of project management education and scheduled PMP exam, with application accepted in July 2026.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Plan, budget tracker, and closure report for a regulatory project (verifiable by change framework office acceptance reference and PMP application acceptance email).
skills: Project Management (PMP), Regulatory Reporting, Change Management Framework, Budgeting, Steering Committee Reporting, Dependency Management, Closure Documentation
